Hebrew Rashi OCR model

Model from Pninim / AvtechScientific (Zeev Pekar), distributed from
https://github.com/AvtechScientific/tessdata_contrib/tree/main/heb_rashi
under the accompanying Apache License 2.0.

Original project: https://gitlab.com/pninim.org/tessdata_heb_rashi
Training documentation: https://github.com/AvtechScientific/tessdata_contrib/blob/main/heb_rashi/TRAINING.md

SeferStudio redistributes the unchanged best-model weights as a gzip file.
This community-contributed model is not an endorsement by Tesseract or OpenAI.
See PROVENANCE.json for exact content hashes.
